* stats_correlate
.param a__z__r='agauss(0, 1, 1)'
.param a__z=a__z__r
.param a='(1) + (100m)*((1e0)*a__z)'
.param b__z__r='agauss(0, 1, 1)'
.param b__z=b__z__r
.param b='(2) + ((2)*(200m)/100)*((6e-1)*a__z + (8e-1)*b__z)'
.param c__mc='agauss(3, 300m, 1)'
.param c=c__mc
R1 x 0 'a+b+c'
I1 0 x 1m
.op
.end
